lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular clusters are arranged in three primary longitudinal rows posterior to the gill slits. The centroids in the medial row exhibit higher pixel intensity and larger diameters compared to the dorsal and ventral rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of diffuse elevated intensity intersect the longitudinal spot rows, forming a visible grid where the highest-intensity blobs serve as vertices within the vertical stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal feature is visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with a light superior edge and a shadowed inferior edge, running parallel to the dorsal midline.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin displays a dense distribution of small, high-luminance spots across the distal and posterior regions, with a higher concentration along the leading edge.
